rootCause: The mobile prototype port did not project persisted collaborative-deck object proposals into a proposal-specific review model.
symptom: An element-scoped deck request could lose its proposal-specific before and proposed values and present generic or stale accepted copy.
evidence: commit f2c14352; docs/release/proof/20260714/authenticated-mobile-deck-proposal-390x844.png; deployed-auth-first-user governed deck journey PASS
fix: Project live deck object patches into Before and Proposed review content and route approval through the persisted proposal.

rootCause: The proposal card rendered an unbounded list of full trace identifiers before its action footer.
symptom: Deck proposal Reject and Approve controls could fall below the initial phone review viewport.
evidence: docs/release/proof/20260714/authenticated-mobile-deck-proposal-390x844.png; Playwright asserts both controls are visible and in viewport at 390x844
fix: Show two compact trace chips, summarize overflow, and retain the action footer in the first review viewport.

rootCause: ArtifactSheet read the room-wide mobile evidence projection instead of evidence derived from the persisted deck storyboard and its source artifact IDs.
symptom: The deck Evidence tab could show an unrelated or empty evidence state after a sourced proposal was approved.
evidence: commit 8b8afc98; docs/release/proof/20260714/authenticated-mobile-deck-390x844.png; live proof reports 5 scoped sources, 11 claims, 0 verified
fix: Build evidence from the persisted deck storyboard and source artifacts, preserving needs_review and verified-claim counts.

rootCause: Static landing, tour, mobile seed, and fallback copy retained the previous anonymous-room product contract after production identity enforcement was enabled.
symptom: Launch surfaces still said no account or public-by-default, and the mobile first viewport did not disclose sign-in before a CTA.
fix: Align all touched launch copy with account-bound membership and expose Sign-in required on the server-rendered and hydrated first viewport.

rootCause: The long-running workflow can expose early tool progress while the broader multi-step job continues; this pass did not prove a terminal completion SLA or reload recovery for that job.
symptom: A broad desktop evidence-gap NodeAgent request emitted a real Tool event but had not reached a terminal job state in the captured launch proof window.
evidence: docs/release/proof/20260714/authenticated-desktop-ai-elements-tool-1440x900.png shows running 1/20; the E2E cancels and verifies cancelled when not complete
fix: OPEN: add durable checkpoint/reload proof and a bounded terminal-state SLA test for the broad agent journey.

rootCause: The current proposal UI and schema projection do not expose a canonical job-to-proposal identifier relationship.
symptom: The governed deck proposal shows sources and context traces but no direct visible jobId linking the proposal to the producing agent run.
evidence: docs/release/proof/20260714/authenticated-mobile-deck-proposal-390x844.png; proposal source and trace chips are visible but no jobId is present
fix: OPEN: persist and render the canonical producing jobId on proposal and trace receipts.

rootCause: The current Convex Auth password flow has no email verification challenge in the launch journey.
symptom: Password sign-up establishes an account without proving ownership of the entered email address.
evidence: e2e/deployed-auth-first-user.spec.ts signs up fresh password users and reaches authenticated rooms; no verification step exists in that path
fix: OPEN: add verified-email delivery/challenge or label the identifier as unverified and define the launch threat model.

rootCause: The deployed first-user screenshot calls captured the full page without masking the room-code control.
symptom: Authenticated desktop proof screenshots exposed the temporary room access code in the top bar.
fix: Mask .r-roomcode in authenticated desktop Playwright screenshots and rerun all live journeys.
Lease-fence each slice, schedule exact expiry callbacks, terminalize the job and stream deterministically, release active leases, and assert completed status after reload.
evidence: commit 6d35f112; commit 6c621e3c; tests/agentJobsRuntime.test.ts lease, cancel, expiry, and watchdog cases; e2e/deployed-auth-first-user.spec.ts terminal completed state survives reload; npm run prod:gate PASS; docs/release/proof/20260714/p1-launch-hardening-receipt.json
rootCause: Long-running job slices did not have a deterministic lease watchdog that terminalized abandoned work and preserved the final public stream state.
symptom: A broad desktop evidence-gap NodeAgent request emitted a real Tool event but had not reached a terminal job state in the captured launch proof window.

fix: Persist proposal jobId and project it into workpapers, traces, desktop review, and mobile review without weakening proposal approval.
evidence: commit 6d35f112; tests/workArtifacts.test.ts; tests/mobileProposalInbox.test.tsx; desktop proposal-review-job and mobile producing-job receipt selectors; npm run prod:gate PASS; docs/release/proof/20260714/p1-launch-hardening-receipt.json
rootCause: Proposal records and UI adapters did not carry the producing agent job identifier through the governed artifact path.
symptom: The governed deck proposal shows sources and context traces but no direct visible jobId linking the proposal to the producing agent run.

fix: Require an emailed eight-digit challenge and emailVerificationTime before session creation; fail closed when mail is absent; keep the unprovisioned password path hidden in production.
evidence: commit 6d35f112; tests/authEmailVerification.test.ts; tests/accountGate.test.tsx; npm run prod:gate PASS; production account gate is GitHub-only while mail is unprovisioned; docs/release/proof/20260714/p1-launch-hardening-receipt.json
rootCause: The password provider had no email verification challenge and session creation did not require a verified-email timestamp.
symptom: Password sign-up establishes an account without proving ownership of the entered email address.

rootCause: Several production environment values had been written with shell line endings, which Convex preserved and GitHub encoded as percent-0D.
symptom: Live GitHub OAuth and external agent providers received values with trailing carriage returns.
evidence: Live GitHub redirect before normalization contained percent-0D; after file-based rewrite the redirect contains the exact client ID and correct zealous-goshawk-766 callback; Convex environment audit reports zero remaining control-character warnings; docs/release/proof/20260714/p1-launch-hardening-receipt.json
fix: Rewrite every affected live value through a UTF-8 no-BOM temporary file with no line ending, then audit the actual target again.
